config.invistags.title: InvisTags
config.invistags.showInvisibleSkin.toolt: Renders the body and skin of invisible players at full opacity.
config.invistags.showInvisibleNametag.to: Forces nametags above invisible players to render at full opacity, at any distance.
config.invistags.showInvisibleMobs.toolt: Renders invisible mobs at full opacity and shows nametags for custom-named invisible mobs.
config.invistags.showInvisibleGear: Reveal invisible players' armour and held items
config.invistags.showInvisibleGear.toolt: Restores armour and held items that servers strip from invisible players, using the last gear your client saw. Gear the server never sent cannot be recovered.
config.invistags.flagVanishedPlayers.too: Marks player entities the server sent but hid from the tab list, with a red [VANISHED] nametag suffix and a chat alert. Skipped when the server does not use the tab list.
config.invistags.rememberState.tooltip: On by default. When off, skins, nametags, mobs, gear and the vanished flag always start disabled. Turn it on to keep the current toggles across restarts.
config.invistags.hint: Keys can be changed in Options > Controls > Key Binds. Mob reveal, gear reveal and the vanished flag are config/command only.
